newsitem.title: USA: Lawrence Savings sets holder right plan.
newsitem.headline: Lawrence Savings sets holder right plan.

text.p: Lawrence Savings Bank said Friday that it has adopted a stockholder rights plan that would take effect if more than 10 percent of the company's common stock were acquired.

The plan is not aimed at preventing a takeover, but at ensuring "that any potential acquiror negotiates with Lawrence Savings Bank's board of directors prior to attempting a takeover," the company said in a release.
The plan gives one preferred stock purchase right as a dividend for each Lawrence Savings common share held as of December 29.
The rights would let Lawrence Savings common shareholders buy more common shares at about one-half market value if the 10 percent trigger were reached, the company said.
